description: OpenAI has introduced a new safety system called Control Room. It works alongside misalignment monitoring systems. It works alongside misalignment monitoring systems. If a monitor detects a problem, it can signal Control Room to terminate the job ID, denying further inference requests. OpenAI says Control Room can stop further model output within a maximum of 35 seconds after receiving a stop instruction.
title: OpenAI Introduces Control Room to Stop AI Models Quickly When Safety Concerns Arise

description: Meta has added smartwatch support to its Muse AI assistant, with the Apple Watch app arriving through version 15.0 of its iPhone app. The update brings the assistant's animated character to the wearable and lets users add a shortcut to their watch face. Meta has also mentioned compatibility with Google's Wear OS platform. The move follows the company's introduction of Muse Charm, a dedicated AI companion device, at its Connect 2026 event in September.
title: Meta Muse AI Assistant Arrives on Apple Watch With Watch Face Shortcut

description: Binance has warned iPhone users about a potential iOS security vulnerability known as worse_query, which could allow malicious applications to access files belonging to other apps. The issue reportedly affects multiple iOS 26 and iOS 27 versions and could expose sensitive information, including cryptocurrency wallet recovery phrases and private keys. The exchange advised users to remove untrusted applications, update their software, and create new wallet credentials on a fresh device if they suspect their information has been compromised. There is currently no confirmed evidence of cryptocurrency theft linked to the vulnerability.
title: Binance Spots iOS Bug That Could Put Cryptocurrency Wallet Keys at Risk

description: Apple's new Intelligence Usage Packs let Logic Pro users purchase additional AI usage once they exhaust their monthly allowance. The one-time purchase costs $49.99 (around Rs. 4,700) in the US. Apple is expected to extend the option to Final Cut Pro, Pixelmator Pro and the iWork suite. The company will also introduce usage limits for some server-based Apple Intelligence features in 2027, including Siri AI and Image Playground.
title: Apple Intelligence Features Get Paid Usage Packs as Monthly Limits Come Into Play

description: Samsung's Galaxy Wearable app reportedly contains references to HMG Edition watch faces. The company may use the customised designs for the Galaxy Watch 9 and Galaxy Watch Ultra 2. The special-edition watch faces are likely intended for Hyundai executives and may not be released commercially.
title: Samsung Galaxy Watch 9, Watch Ultra 2 Could Get HMG Edition Watch Faces, Suggests APK Teardown

description: Infinix Smart 30e 5G and  Tecno Camon 60 Pro surfaced on the EEC Website. The Infinix Smart 30e 5G carries the model number X6864B, while the Tecno Camon 60 Pro 5G has the model number CO7. The certification listing does not reveal the specifications of either smartphone. However, the appearance of the devices in the database suggests that they could soon launch in global markets.
title: Tecno Camon 60 Pro 5G, Infinix Smart 30e 5G Reportedly Spotted on EEC Website; May Launch Soon

description: WhatsApp has started testing a new Contacts tab for iOS, according to a report. The feature was spotted being tested in the WhatsApp beta for iOS 26.44.10.70 update. The beta version is currently accessible via TestFlight. The report also highlights details about the upcoming feature. The new WhatsApp Contacts tab for iOS will reportedly list the favourite contacts, along with the list of other saved contacts. The favourite contacts could appear at the top of the screen. On top of this, it might allow users to see the online and last seen status of their saved contacts. However, the report highlights that users will have to allow others to see their current status in the privacy settings menu.
title: WhatsApp to Bring a New Contacts Tab for iOS as Feature Reportedly Starts Rolling Out in Beta

description: Urban Arc Go 2 AI Smart Fitness Band and Q9i AI ANC true wireless stereo (TWS) earbuds were launched in India on Tuesday. As per the company, the fitness band focuses on health and activity tracking. It features an AI-powered Recovery Function, more than 110 sports modes, and a claimed battery life of up to 45 days. The Q9i earbuds, meanwhile, offer ANC, AI-powered live translation across more than 50 languages, and an integrated smartphone stand.
title: Urban Arc Go 2 Fitness Band, Q9i AI ANC TWS Earbuds Launched in India: Price, Specifications

description: Oppo's PNC110 has appeared on China's MIIT certification website with images showing its front and rear design. The handset is seen with a purple finish, a flat display and two rear camera sensors. An earlier certification listing reportedly revealed a rated battery capacity of 11,640mAh, which could translate to a typical capacity of 12,000mAh. The phone may belong to Oppo's upcoming A-series range, although its final name, launch date and other key specifications remain unknown.
title: Oppo's Rumoured 12,000mAh Battery Smartphone Gets an Early Look Through MIIT Listing

description: North Korean hackers linked to the $6.3 billion Binance theft allegedly created six memecoins to disguise stolen cryptocurrency as legitimate trading proceeds. According to blockchain analytics firm Elliptic, the attackers moved 117,000 NEAR tokens worth approximately $430,000 through these assets between November 5 and November 7. The hackers reportedly used separate wallets to buy and sell the tokens against NEAR, generating artificial trading activity. Elliptic said transactions involving all six memecoins had stopped by November 8.
title: North Korean Hackers Create Memecoins to Launder Proceeds of $6.3 Billion Binance Hack

description: Krafton India announced the release date of the BGMI 4.7 update on Tuesday. The upcoming update is confirmed to bring a new winter-themed experience to Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI). The experience is called Arctic Chronicles and draws inspiration from Jormungandr, the colossal serpent from Norse mythology, and will transform parts of the battleground across Erangel, Livik and Vikendi. Krafton said that the update will also introduce additional seasonal experiences over the following weeks.
title: BGMI 4.7 Update Release Date Announced; to Feature Norse Mythology-Inspired Arctic Chronicles Mode

description: Meta's Muse Ember is designed to help developers build AI agents that can handle routine work without relying on larger models for every step. It can process text, images, audio and video, and supports a context window of up to 1 million tokens. Meta has also published benchmark results comparing it with models from Anthropic and OpenAI. Developers can access Muse Ember through the Meta Model API and Muse Code, with separate rates for input, output and cached tokens.
title: Meta Launches Muse Ember AI Model for Coding and Automated Tasks

description: Amid several leaks and rumours about the iPhone Air 2 and the iPhone 18, there’s now a new video showcasing what the source claims are the final designs of the two smartphones. While the iPhone Air 2’s design appears familiar, the iPhone 18 has grown bigger in size similar to the iPhone 16 Plus.
title: iPhone Air 2, iPhone 18 Dummy Units Leak, Revealing Camera Design Changes

description: The Oppo Pad Air 6 will come in Wi-Fi and 5G versions, with expandable storage reserved for the cellular model. Both variants will support Wi-Fi 6 and feature 8-megapixel cameras on the front and rear. Other listed features include ColorOS 17, face unlock and a quad-speaker system. Chinese buyers will get three memory configurations and two colour choices. Pre-orders are open through Oppo's online store, but pricing and the retail date have not been announced for the tablet just yet.
title: Oppo Pad Air 6 Full Specifications List Revealed Ahead of November 16 Launch

description: Google is reportedly planning to roll out a new update for the Digital Wellbeing tool, a report highlights. The upcoming features are currently being tested as part of the Digital Wellbeing v1.50.1015162751 beta version, the report highlights. The beta version reportedly renames the Weekly Wrap feature to Weekly Insights. The feature is said to provide AI-generated summaries for “raw screen-time metrics”. Further, Digital Wellbeing’s Weekly Insights tool is said to lay the groundwork for deeper Gemini AI integration. After being enabled, Weekly Insights will reportedly send a notification to users every week. Android users can tap on the alert to see multiple “recap slides”. The first slide will reportedly present screen-time data from the past week, along with a daily average screen time for browsers, tools, communication, and “other”.
title: Google Plans to Update Android’s Digital Wellbeing Tool With ‘Weekly Insights’, Gemini AI Integration: Report

description: Google on Monday announced a new way for developers to add real-world location data and mapping features to applications built using its AI tools. As per the Mountain View-based tech giant, developers will be able to access Google Maps Platform directly within Google AI Studio. This, as per Google, allows them to create interactive maps, local search tools, and route-planning applications without leaving the development environment. The integration is also claimed to simplify the process of configuring API credentials and connecting Google Cloud projects.
title: Google AI Studio Adds Google Maps Integration for Building Interactive Maps, Route Planning Apps

description: Google has started rolling out a new Memory summary feature for its Gemini AI assistant. The feature gives users more control over the personal information Gemini retains from their previous conversations. Google's official support information currently lists the US as the supported region. It seems the feature is working through a browser for some users outside the US, including on free accounts.
title: Google Gemini Memory Summary Feature Rolls Out With Options to Edit and Delete Saved Details

description: Bitcoin erased its post-election gains on Friday as a sharp sell-off in global technology and AI stocks weighed on cryptocurrency markets. The decline triggered $1.08 billion in liquidations over 24 hours, mostly involving leveraged bullish positions. Investors are also monitoring US employment data, Federal Reserve rate expectations, and institutional ETF flows for signs of further market direction.
title: Bitcoin Slips Below $75,000 as $1.2 Billion in Crypto Liquidations Deepen Market Pressure

description: Samsung Galaxy S27, Galaxy S27+, Galaxy S27 Pro, and Galaxy S27 Ultra camera specifications have surfaced online. The Samsung Galaxy S27 and Galaxy S27+ could be equipped with a triple rear camera unit, led by a 50-megapixel primary shooter with a Sony IMX955 or a Samsung S5KGNG sensor, the same as their predecessors. Moreover, the phones could also carry a 12-megapixel ultrawide camera with a Sony IMX564 sensor, which the company has used for the last two generations. The two will reportedly sport a telephoto camera with up to 3x optical zoom and a Samsung S5K3K1 sensor. On the front, the handsets are said to boast either a Samsung S5K3LU or Sony IMX874 sensor for selfies and video calls.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Series Leak Suggests Familiar Camera Configurations and Sensors: Report

description: The OnePlus 16 was launched in China recently, and rumours about its potential successor have already begun surfacing. A tipster claims that the purported handset, dubbed OnePlus 17, could adopt a wider display. With this move, OnePlus is believed to be moving away from the tall, narrow display format seen on several recent smartphones. As per the tipster, the OnePlus 17 could join a growing group of Android flagships that prioritise a wider screen for gaming and other content.
title: OnePlus 17 Tipped to Feature Wider Display, Could Focus on Mobile Gaming

description: Vivo has reportedly filed a trademark for the ‘vivo Pocket’ name at the United States Patent and Trademark Office. The trademark has been filed and applies to a variety of cameras, gimbals and photographic accessories that may or may not be launched under the brand, now secured by the Chinese smartphone manufacturer.
title: Vivo’s First Gimbal Camera May Be Called the ‘Pocket’ as Company Files Trademark at USPTO

description: The Vivo X500 Ultra is rumoured to be in development as the latest addition to the flagship X500 series, which already comprises the Vivo X500, X500 Pro, and X500 Pro Max. While the company has yet to announce the handset, a tipster has shared some details about its camera system. It is tipped to come equipped with LOFIC (Lateral Overflow Integration Capacitor) technology. This is expected to enable full-sensor HDR imaging on the Vivo X500 Ultra.
title: Vivo X500 Ultra Tipped to Get Dual Sony LYT-L910 Sensors With LOFIC Technology for Main, Ultrawide Cameras

description: Anthropic has launched Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 AI models, the AI giant announced on Monday. The Claude Fable 5.2 AI model is currently available via Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and other platforms. Developers can access the model via the Claude platform. Moreover, for this week, Anthropic is offering higher usage limits to paid users. Meanwhile, Mythos 5.2 can be accessed by select cybersecurity professionals via the Cyber Verification Program, while Enterprise users can get it via Claude Security. The Dario Amodei-led AI lab claims that Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 deliver enhancements on multiple fronts. Both AI models are claimed to generate outputs up to 30 percent faster. The Fast Mode further speeds up token generation by up to 2.5 times. Fable 5.2 outperformed Google’s frontier Gemini 4 Carbon AI model on multiple benchmarks.
title: Anthropic Launches Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 AI Models With Improved Coding and Reasoning Capabilities

description: Vivo is said to be mass-producing a battery with a rated capacity of 11,970mAh. If the leak turns out to be accurate, Vivo could introduce a smartphone featuring a battery with a typical capacity of around 12,000mAh. The name of the phone has not been revealed yet. The company's next foldable phone could arrive with a conventional or wider display design.
title: Vivo Said to Be Testing Smartphone With 12,000mAh Battery

description: Meta Platforms announced the expansion of its AI-powered age estimation technology for Instagram to global markets on Tuesday. As per the social media giant, its capability is aimed at identifying teenage users on Instagram, even when they have entered an adult date of birth while creating an account. The company is also stepping up its communication with parents, courtesy of which users in the US will begin receiving Instagram notifications explaining how the technology works later this month.
title: Instagram Expands AI-Powered Age Verification Worldwide to Protect Teen Users

description: Samsung is said to be testing a new feature called Bixby Work, which could let its voice assistant run tasks in the background. The feature is reportedly designed to handle everyday requests, including booking hotel rooms, scheduling appointments, and setting up recurring tasks. This could be available in One UI 9.5.  The update could debut with the Galaxy S27 series early next year.
title: Samsung One UI 9.5 Could Turn Bixby Into an AI Agent for Handling Daily Tasks

description: Motorola's next foldable smartphone could arrive with a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset and 12GB of RAM. The Razr Flex 2027 is also tipped to feature a 6.92-inch inner screen, a 4.97-inch cover display and two 50-megapixel rear cameras. Other expected specifications include a 5,000mAh battery, Android 17 and IP48 and IP49 ratings. The handset could be offered in Dark Botanical Garden and Coriander colour options. Motorola has not confirmed these details or announced the phone's launch plans yet.
title: Motorola Razr Flex 2027 Official Support Page Goes Live Ahead of Expected Launch

description: Pre-orders for Grand Theft Auto 6 are tracking "far in excess" of Take-Two's initial expectations, the company said during its second-quarter FY 2027 earnings call on Monday. Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick sounded confident about the game's launch and said that "the numbers will speak for themselves soon enough".
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Pre-Orders Are Tracking 'Far in Excess' of Take-Two's Expectactions Ahead of Launch

description: Meta has revealed the India pricing of the Muse personal AI agent, according to a report. The Mark Zuckerberg-led tech giant will reportedly offer the service at a starting price of Rs. 1,799 for the Power subscription. On the other hand, the higher-end Maximum plan is said to cost Rs. 8,999. However, the report does not specify whether these prices are for monthly or yearly payment plans. In the US, the company only offers monthly payment options for both tiers at similar prices: $20 (roughly Rs. 1,900) and $100 (about Rs. 9,400), respectively. The report also does not mention the benefits the two subscription plans will offer in India. According to Meta’s website, globally, the Power tier offers 500 million Muse tokens per week. On the other hand, the Max plan provides 3 billion Muse tokens every week.
title: Meta’s Muse Personal AI Agent Pricing for India Revealed Ahead of Debut: Report

description: The Dyson Hot+Cool HF1 fan and Dyson Cool tower fan have been launched in India, the company announced on Tuesday. The two Dyson bladeless fans will be available for purchase via the Dyson India online store and the offline Dyson Demo stores across the country, allowing customers to experience the devices. The new Dyson Hot+Cool HF1 fan and Dyson Cool Tower fan are bladeless fans powered by the Air Multiplier technology. Dyson’s technology is claimed to combine the principles used in turbochargers and jet engines to increase the volume of air surrounding the machines to amplify the airflow. The Dyson Hot+Cool HF1 fan is a two-in-one model that can blow warm air during winters and cool air during summers. The company claims that the appliance can increase the temperature of the entire room by 1 degree Celsius in about 100 seconds.
title: Dyson Hot+Cool HF1 Fan, Dyson Cool Tower Fan Launched in India With Air Multiplier Technology: Price, Features
